g.text: Costs on the same observation blocks
ALL 35 ORIGINAL SYNTHETIC CASES. Time includes the statistic implementation, but excludes shared scheduling/input retention and PSI histogram
construction. Main execution computes PSI before KS; small timing differences are machine/order dependent. Payload is histogram arrays for PSI versus
numeric arrays for KS, not total process memory. The engine retains shared inputs and record-ID bookkeeping. Full-engine wall time and shared peak RSS
are in the raw manifest. These are implementation costs, not a universal efficiency claim.
